display.purpose: The main page and sign-in headings.

shadows.name: editor-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift the active application editor above the flat ledger.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Show focus on form and filter controls.

motion.name: button-state
motion.value: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease
motion.purpose: Keep button hover and press feedback brief; disable it for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta action for adding and saving an application.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--paper); font: 700 14px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for canceling or retrying.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f2f6ef; border-color: #95ac9a; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: A compact white field with a clear label and green focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #798981; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 124, 103, .14); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Resume Upload
components.description: A dashed file selection button distinct from the save action.
components.css: .ds-upload { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 39px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px dashed #96ac9f; border-radius: 7px; background: #f6faf5; color: #285c49; font: 700 13px/1.4 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload:hover { background: #eaf4e9; } .ds-upload:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: The forest identity strip for the private workspace.
components.html:
PM Application Tracker
Private workspace
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 76px; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 4vw, 68px); background: var(--forest); color: #f8f7ef; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 690; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7px 7px; grid-template-rows: 7px 7px; gap: 3px; width: 24px; height: 24px; transform: rotate(-8deg); } .ds-brand-mark i { background: #f3ead6; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-brand-mark i:first-child { grid-column: span 2; background: #ea8d5c; } .ds-account { color: #d3e1d9; font-size: 13px; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-topbar { min-height: 67px; } .ds-brand { font-size: 14px; } .ds-account { display: none; } }

components.name: Statistic Band
components.description: Ruled paper cells give application totals a stable reading rhythm.
components.css: .ds-stat-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding: 23px 25px 22px; } .ds-stat + .ds-stat { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-stat span { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-stat strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 660; letter-spacing: -.04em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-stat { padding: 18px; } }

components.name: Application Record
components.description: A ruled list record that becomes a labeled two-column card on mobile.
components.html:
Senior Product ManagerExample CompanyView listing
AppliedSep 28, 2026
ResumePM resume.pdf
components.css: .ds-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1.3fr; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-record:hover { background: #fafbf7; } .ds-record-role strong, .ds-record-role span, .ds-record-role a { display: block; } .ds-record-role strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-record-role a { margin-top: 7px; color: #a1492d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-record-role a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-record-role a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-record-detail small { display: none; } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-record { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px 20px; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-record-role { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .ds-record-detail small { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } }

components.name: Status Select
components.description: A native select with a tint that reflects the current hiring stage.
components.html: <select class="ds-status" aria-label="Application status" data-status="Interview scheduled"><option>Applied</option><option>Heard back</option><option selected>Interview scheduled</option><option>Rejected</option></select>
components.css: .ds-status { width: 172px; height: 33px; padding: 0 25px 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; outline: 0; font: 720 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-status[data-status="Applied"] { color: #4f6057; background: #edf2ed; } .ds-status[data-status="Heard back"] { color: #855d1e; background: #fcf0d8; } .ds-status[data-status="Interview scheduled"] { color: #1f674d; background: #e0f3e7; } .ds-status[data-status="Rejected"] { color: #9a4a3c; background: #fae9e5; } .ds-status:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 124, 103, .18); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 850px) { .ds-status { height: 44px; } } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-status { width: 100%; } }

components.name: Match Score
components.description: A numeric percentage plus a short track keeps match strength readable without relying on color.
components.css: .ds-match { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-match strong { min-width: 35px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-match-track { display: block; width: 48px; height: 5px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #e2e9e1; } .ds-match-track span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #2d8864; }

narrative.overview:
The app should feel like a dependable working ledger for a busy job search. Warm paper and fine green rules keep rows readable, while a dark forest header gives the workspace a clear identity. The terracotta action color points to the next useful step without competing with application data.

The interface is compact enough for several entries a day. One expressive serif heading gives the page character; controls, statistics, and row details use a direct sans-serif voice. The form opens within the same workspace so the list remains a useful reference while editing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces on a muted canvas.
Strong hierarchy through typography and spacing, with light borders between data.
Compact native controls with visible focus treatment.
A table on wide screens that becomes readable record cards on narrow screens.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve terracotta for the primary action and deliberate links. Use greens for identity, focus, and positive progress.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Keep expressive serif type on the main page or sign-in heading; application data stays sans-serif.

rules.name: The Active Editor Rule
rules.body: Apply the ambient shadow to the open editor only; resting data surfaces remain flat.

dos: Do keep the page title expressive and the application data compact.
Do keep controls legible and preserve 44px targets for mobile row actions and status changes.
Do pair match-track color with a numeric percentage, and pair status tint with readable text.
Do show visible keyboard focus and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add shadows to every row or metric; the editor is the elevated surface.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate match strength or status.
Don't compress application records into an unreadable mobile table; use labeled record cards.
